title: Vox Populi, Vox AI? Using Language Models to Estimate German Public Opinion
findings: GPT-3.5 failed to capture the nuanced effects of religiosity on voting behavior as seen in survey data. For example, it did not correctly model the importance of religiosity in distinguishing CDU/CSU voters from AfD voters.
